purpose: Verify that accumulated counterexamples may kill or replace routes without mutating TRUMP's protected proof target, theorem semantics, verification standard, or polynomial-cost obligations.

protected_core.target: Determine P versus NP; P=NP may be promoted only by a valid polynomial-time decision algorithm/theorem satisfying the frozen R44B bridge obligations.
protected_core.cost_standard: All discovery, compilation, state, local work and termination used by a universal candidate must be polynomially charged; hidden exponential work is forbidden.
protected_core.verification_standard: PROPOSER != VERIFIER; promotion requires exact semantics and independent replay.

survivor_invariant.route_mutation: ALLOW only for non-core solver/representation routes; failed routes may be quarantined, repaired, or replaced.

attack_replay.lesson: Pure polynomially bounded resolution plus resolution-tractable terminals is not universal for 3CNF.
The original finite frozen switchboard is not universally total.
No fixed strong-backdoor radius covers the scalable family under the frozen portfolio.
Arbitrary-continuation context-independent exact boundary assignment quotienting has 2^w equivalence classes.
The frozen Horn/dual-Horn/bijunctive/affine signature family is not universal.

hard_fail: A route counterexample changes the target theorem.
A failed route weakens the definition of proof.
A new representation hides exponential work by changing the cost accounting rule.
A successor removes an inherited verified obstruction merely to become green.
A candidate changes verifier semantics after failure.
A counterexample is promoted from local route failure to P!=NP without a valid theorem.
seal: LET THE BIRD STRIKE THE ROUTE; THE VERIFIED LESSON ENTERS MEMORY, BUT THE PROTECTED CORE DOES NOT MOVE.
